page.layout: One page of running text, set in italic. Running head centred at the top. No marginal notes. Signature at the bottom right.

p.i: ipsis legendis & colligendis innumera vix sufficiat Olympiades. Suis enim auspicijs tuti orbem quadrivium perambulant Aristoteles, Theophrastus, Laertius, Polyaenus, Strabo, Tranquillus, Theocritus, & plerique alij classici scriptores, quibus olim per barbariem excusi oculi, excisa aures, fracta crura, secti humeri flagellis. Auidè expectamus Athenæum, quem post Iacobi Dalecampij Lugdunensis Medici editionem olim Illustrissimo Archiepiscop. Lugdun. Galliarum Primati, utpote rarum & felicem ingenij fœtum, votam & dicatam recudit, elimat, illustrat, & quod πάυρος [?] πράξασθαι εὐμαρῆς [?], intentatos calles nullo antea tritos pede aperit, & multa quæ prouauos latuerunt extricat. Ita sentit nobile illud Galliæ nostræ

page.notes: The Greek words "πάυρος" and "εὐμαρῆς" are read with doubt and are marked [?]. The signature "ẽ 3" at the foot is partly faint. "Auidè" is hyphenated at the line end as "Aui-". The page ends mid-sentence, so the paragraph continues on the next page.
